source_text: LEONTES. Thou want’st a rough pash and the shoots that I have To be full like me:—yet they say we are Almost as like as eggs; women say so, That will say anything. But were they false As o’er-dy’d blacks, as wind, as waters, false As dice are to be wish’d by one that fixes No bourn ’twixt his and mine, yet were it true To say this boy were like me. Come, sir page, Look on me with your welkin eye: sweet villain! Most dear’st! my collop! Can thy dam?—may’t be? Affection! thy intention stabs the centre: Thou dost make possible things not so held, Communicat’st with dreams;—how can this be?— With what’s unreal thou coactive art, And fellow’st nothing: then ’tis very credent Thou may’st co-join with something; and thou dost, And that beyond commission, and I find it, And that to the infection of my brains And hardening of my brows.
modern_text: LEONTES. You need a rough head and the horns I have to be quite my image. And yet they say we're as alike as eggs—women say so, who'll say anything. But even if they were false as ill-dyed black clothes, as wind, as water—false as dice are wished by a man who sets no boundary between his and another's—still it would be true to say this boy looks like me. Come, page, look at me with your sky-blue eye: sweet villain! Dearest! My own flesh! Can your mother—? Could it be? Suspicion! Your reach pierces the heart of things. You make impossible things believable, you commune with dreams—how can this be?—You work hand in hand with what's unreal, you partner with nothing. So it's very believable you may also partner with something. And you do, beyond your warrant—and I find it, and it sickens my brain and stiffens my brow with the horns of a cuckold.

source_text: TIME. I that please some, try all: both joy and terror Of good and bad, that makes and unfolds error, Now take upon me, in the name of Time, To use my wings. Impute it not a crime To me or my swift passage, that I slide O’er sixteen years, and leave the growth untried Of that wide gap, since it is in my power To o’erthrow law, and in one self-born hour To plant and o’erwhelm custom. Let me pass The same I am, ere ancient’st order was Or what is now received. I witness to The times that brought them in; so shall I do To th’ freshest things now reigning, and make stale The glistering of this present, as my tale Now seems to it. Your patience this allowing, I turn my glass, and give my scene such growing As you had slept between. Leontes leaving Th’ effects of his fond jealousies, so grieving That he shuts up himself, imagine me, Gentle spectators, that I now may be In fair Bohemia, and remember well, I mentioned a son o’ th’ king’s, which Florizel I now name to you; and with speed so pace To speak of Perdita, now grown in grace Equal with wondering. What of her ensues I list not prophesy; but let Time’s news Be known when ’tis brought forth. A shepherd’s daughter, And what to her adheres, which follows after, Is th’ argument of Time. Of this allow, If ever you have spent time worse ere now; If never, yet that Time himself doth say He wishes earnestly you never may.
modern_text: TIME. I, who please some and put all to the test—both joy and terror of good and bad alike, who makes errors and unmakes them—now take it upon myself, in the name of Time, to use my wings. Don't count it a crime in me or in my swift passage that I slide over sixteen years and leave untested the growth of that wide gap; since it is in my power to overturn law, and in one self-born hour to plant and overwhelm custom. Let me pass the same as I always was, before the most ancient order existed, or what is now accepted. I was witness to the times that brought those in; and so I am to the freshest things now reigning, and I'll make the glitter of this present go stale, as my tale now seems to it. Allowing this much patience, I turn my glass, and give my scene growth as if you had slept through it. Leontes leaving the effects of his foolish jealousies, so grieving that he shuts himself away, imagine me, gentle spectators, that I may now be in fair Bohemia; and remember well, I mentioned a son of the king's, whom I now name Florizel to you; and with speed I move on to speak of Perdita, now grown in grace equal to wonder. What follows of her I won't prophesy; but let Time's news be known when it's brought forth. A shepherd's daughter, and what attaches to her, that follows after, is Time's argument. Of this be content, if you've ever spent time worse before now; if never, yet Time himself says he earnestly wishes you never may.

source_text: PAULINA. Music, wake her: strike! [Music.] It is time; descend; be stone no more; approach; strike all that look on you with marvel. Come; I'll fill your grave up: stir; no, come away. Bequeath to death your numbness, for from him dear life redeems you. You see, she stirs.
modern_text: PAULINA. Music, awake her: strike! [_Music._] ’Tis time; descend; be stone no more; approach; Strike all that look upon with marvel. Come; I’ll fill your grave up: stir; nay, come away. Bequeath to death your numbness, for from him Dear life redeems you. You perceive she stirs.
